newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Televisa 1997 forward ad revs up 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Televisa 1997 forward ad revs up 9.5 pct.

text.p: Mexican media giant Grupo Televisa SA said Monday its forward advertising revenues for 1997 totaled 5.685 billion pesos on November 15, up from the 4.024 billion pesos (nominal terms) it had deposited on November 15, 1995, for 1996 forward revenues.

The 1997 forward revenues, which Televisa calls its "French Plan" of pre-paying advertising for the upcoming year, are up 9.5 percent in real terms after taking into account the 29 percent inflation over the last 12 months, Televisa said.
Televisa said it hoped to receive more French Plan deposits for 1997 up to the end of the year, with negotiations with advertising clients continuing.

Televisa said that of the 5.685 billion pesos received to date for the 1997 advertising year, 2.692 billion were in cash and 2.993 billion were in short-term documents, with average maturities of 5.2 months.

To compare, Televisa said that of the 4.024 billion pesos deposited for the 1996 advertising year up to November 15, 1995, 2.552 billion were in cash and 1.772 billion were in short-term documents, with average maturities of 3.5 months.
